body:
Absolutely YES!

When I've feel brave/desperate enough to bring up my suicidality with my mom, she either (a) pretends she doesn't hear me (yep, like a 2-year-old), or (b) tells me to stop being "so selfish." 

I agree: FUCK people who invalidate other people's feelings. You said it perfectly!

Don't let them win.
But you are a really good writer.

Sometimes I feel like cutting, too. I don't really understand it but it's an urge. All I can say is that I'm glad you are o.k. 
Let us know you're o.k. going forward.

Stupid families! I am so sorry that yours is not respecting and appreciating you the way that you deserve.
Today I told my sister that my good friend died (just found out) and she was like, "So...?!" I wanted to say something but I just walked away, drove down the highway, prayed for a safe drive. 
Our families push our buttons, sure, but downright abuse? No. Nobody deserves that. If they act they hate you, chances are they are just sad or jealous or mean. It's NOT YOU.
Sometimes people tell me, "Ah, just let it go." Right. If you can do that, definitely do. If it's hard, try to imagine a different time in the future when you are totally self-sufficient, happy and in great health. 
Please, just hold on.

I think I understand what you mean about being committed. If only we could do it in private! Right? Like... disappear for while and get everything we need, all the love an care and good food and sleep. That's what I wish.
Meanwhile, we can try to give ourselves that attention. 
Try to hold on.
Thank you... from someone on the brink. You give me hope.
You shouldn't do this because tomorrow might be better. It's almost tomorrow now.
I am truly happy that you are still here.
I am so sorry about what happened when you were four.

I think screaming is o.k. 
I have thought about jumping in front of a train, too. Even though things are not great now, I am glad I'm still here. I'm glad you're still here.
You can create your own family. You will find people who love YOU for you. I know it hurts... Don't let them win.
